summary.text: Edgar González Jr. is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 23rd District, based in Chicago.

paragraphs.text: According to his Illinois House Democrats biography, he was born and raised in Chicago's Little Village neighborhood and attended Chicago Public Schools, including Whitney Young Magnet High School.
He graduated from Harvard University with a bachelor's degree in government and was a member of Congressman J. Garcia's in-district constituent services staff.
